name: 4-HO-NPT
summary: 4-HO-NPT, also known as 4-hydroxy-N-propyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and putative psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 4-hydroxytryptamine families related to norpsilocin (4-HO-NMT). It was not included by Alexander Shulgin in his 1997 book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved) and its properties and effects in humans are unknown.

pharmacology.text: 4-HO-NPT, also known as 4-hydroxy-N-propyltryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and putative psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 4-hydroxytryptamine families related to norpsilocin (4-HO-NMT). The drug acts as a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist, including of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.en: It is known from laboratory research on serotonin receptors. No medical use exists.
uses.zh: 它出現在血清素受體的實驗室研究中，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它出现在血清素受体的实验室研究中，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: Like 4-HO-NET, it has only one chain on its nitrogen, here a three-carbon propyl group, making it a slightly longer cousin of norpsilocin from magic mushrooms.
fact.zh: 和4-HO-NET一樣，它的氮原子上只有一條鏈，這裡是三碳的丙基，因此算是迷幻蘑菇成分去甲脫磷酸裸蓋菇素稍長一點的近親。
fact.zhHans: 和4-HO-NET一样，它的氮原子上只有一条链，这里是三碳的丙基，因此算是迷幻蘑菇成分去甲脱磷酸裸盖菇素稍长一点的近亲。
